description: For each of 16 South Korean provinces: today's one thing to watch for people working outdoors (chosen by rule from the KMA 05:00 KST forecast and official limits: wind 10 m/s, rain 1 mm/h, snow 1 cm/h, heat/cold plans), low/high temperature, wind, fine-dust grade, the KMA cold/heat-wave impact-forecast level for industry (original wording) and the Ministry of Employment and Labor cumulative work-death count for the latest quarter. Guidance only — workplace rules and the law come first; emergency 119. Refreshed around 07:10 KST — check is_past. Without region: all 16.
